vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Log4j2 JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Log4j2 Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Log4j2 contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability due to the incomplete fix of CVE-2021-44228.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Spring Framework JDK 9+ Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: A Spring MVC or Spring WebFlux application running on JDK 9+ may be vulnerable to remote code execution (RCE) via data binding.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Commons Text Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Commons Text performs variable interpolation, allowing properties to be dynamically evaluated and expanded using script expressions. This allows remote code execution.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: OpenSSL SM2 Decryption Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: OpenSSL contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in the EVP_PKEY_decrypt function due to miscalculation of the output buffer size for SM2 decryption.
The HTTP/2 protocol allows a denial of service (server resource consumption) because request cancellation can reset many streams quickly, as exploited in the wild.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache HTTP Server HTTP Request Smuggling Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Some mod_proxy configurations on Apache HTTP Server versions 2.4.0 through 2.4.55 allow a HTTP Request Smuggling attack via RewriteRule or ProxyPassMatch.
Active exploitation of SQL injection in authentication endpoint observed in the wild.
Exploitation of cross-site scripting in the search parameter resulting in session hijacking.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Spring Framework Denial of Service via SpEL Expression
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Spring Framework can be vulnerable to a denial of service attack via a specially crafted Spring Expression Language (SpEL) expression.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: SnakeYaml Constructor Deserialization Remote Code Execution
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: SnakeYaml's Constructor() class does not restrict types which can be instantiated during deserialization. Deserializing yaml content provided by an attacker can lead to RCE or denial of service.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Django SQL Injection via QuerySet Methods
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Django QuerySet.annotate(), aggregate(), and extra() methods are subject to SQL injection in column aliases using a crafted dictionary as the kwargs.
